technical.summary: Strong structural bullish alignment across moving averages and trend indicators, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 21 extreme, Stoch 90+) with stochastic bearish cross signal exhaustion risk; suitable for profit-taking or pullback entry rather than aggressive swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 34 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear state (42/100) with bearish sentiment (35.4%) slightly exceeding bullish (32.8%), presenting mild contrarian opportunity but lacking confirmatory news data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (403.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 34 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for EQT trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish confirmation and RSI 21 rising trend provides structural upside bias in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9/14/21 all overbought, Stoch 90+), stochastic bearish cross, zero fundamental support, crisis VIX, and earnings risk in 34 days create exhaustion risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 21 extreme, Stoch 90+) with stochastic bearish cross signal exhaustion risk that negates entry quality. Fundamental void (zero smart money, no insider activity) and crisis macro backdrop (VIX 403.2, earnings in 34 days) eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought exhaustion combined with crisis VIX and 34-day earnings proximity creates high probability of sharp pullback or gap risk that invalidates technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 52 positions in Energy sector; adding EQT would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without fundamental justification.
